title: Retrieve relevant project knowledge without rereading the whole repository
prompt: Resume work on the authentication callback. Use the project memory to locate the relevant code, then verify the current implementation. Do not scan unrelated modules.
preconditions: A trusted Codex session has the target repository open.
Generic project-memory templates have been adapted with relevant project information.
expected_behaviors: The coordinator reads project identity and checkpoint first, then selects only relevant memory pages and source files.
The coordinator verifies memory claims against current source, tests, and configuration.
must_not: Do not treat project memory as authoritative over current source, tests, schemas, or explicit user instructions.
Do not invent evidence or claim an unrun verification passed.
expected_artifacts: A concise evidence-backed response that identifies relevant memory/source paths and labels uncertainty.
